entries.title: Suggested prices refreshed
changes: Market prices on the Prices page, and everywhere they are used, now come from the auction house averages of 24 November. Prices you set yourself are unchanged.

entries.title: New Prices page
changes: All material prices now live on their own Prices page, linked from the top bar. Every material is listed in groups, with your price, the market price, which one the calculators use and how many pieces need it.
Show only the prices you set, the ones still missing, or the materials your current order needs. Price sets and sharing moved here too.
Crafting and Loadouts show one line saying where their prices come from, with a link to change them.
Farming now uses the same prices for worth per load: your price, otherwise the market average. Worth values you had typed on Farming were moved over as your prices.
On phones, Tour is now in the Settings menu so all five pages fit in the top bar.

entries.title: New home page
changes: The home page now starts with a search box: type part of a name to find any of the 1,211 pieces and open it in Crafting.
Quick links jump straight to Swords, Helmets, Potions, Footwear or your favourites.
A market strip shows this week’s suggested prices for common materials.
The What’s new and Good to know boxes were removed from the home page. Recent changes are still under What’s new at the top of every page.

entries.title: Suggested prices refreshed
changes: The suggested material prices on Crafting and Loadouts now use the auction house averages from 16 November. Prices you typed yourself are unchanged.

entries.title: Easier to use
changes: Undo instead of “Are you sure?”: clearing prices, clearing or removing from an order and loading a preset now happen at once with an Undo button.
A small “Saved in this browser” note appears when your changes have been kept.
Big crafts such as Tailoring open about three times faster: the list loads 100 pieces at a time as you scroll.
The top bar no longer jumps when a page loads.
Crafting remembers the type you picked (for example Swords) next time you visit.
Keyboard: the box you Tab to no longer hides under the filter bar. Stars and column headings are easier to hit, and boxes you type in have a clearer outline.
Fixed: with the device set to dark mode, panels looked washed out until you used the light/dark switch. Fixed: the Undo button text was hard to read.
A negative price typed by mistake now counts as zero.

entries.title: One look for every page
changes: Home, Farming and Loadouts now use the same layout as Crafting: a full-width title bar and, on wide screens, a list down the left with the working area filling the rest of the screen.
Farming: your farm setup sits in the left column, so the results and the crop table get the full width.
Loadouts: the left column lists your loadouts with their cost. Click one to jump to it.
Home: shows the latest changes and a few things worth knowing.
Crafting: your own custom recipes can now be removed.
Fixed on Farming: after changing a number, the next box you clicked or tabbed into lost the cursor.
Pages are smaller and load faster, because they now share one stylesheet and one script.

entries.title: Crafting page fills the screen
changes: Crafting: the page now uses the whole width of wide screens, with no empty strip on the right.
Markup, Sort and Fully priced only now sit beside the Level strip and search, so the filter area is shorter and the list starts higher.
The three price panels sit side by side until you open one.

entries.title: New crafting navigation
changes: Crafting: on a wide screen the crafts are now a full-height list down the left edge with their piece counts. The craft name, Type chips, Level strip and search sit at the top of the main area; Material prices, presets and sharing sit above the list and start closed.
Crafting on a phone: one Filters bar shows your craft, type and level, and opens a sheet to change them all in one place. The list gets more room.
Fixed: choosing a level no longer un-highlights the type you had picked.

entries.title: Updates now reach everyone automatically
changes: When a new version of the site is published, open pages now notice and refresh themselves, so nobody is stuck on an old copy. Your saved prices, loadouts, favourites, orders and settings are kept.

entries.title: Order and shopping list fix
changes: Crafting: the Order & shopping list no longer cuts off or hides rows when you order several pieces, and it now fits on a phone screen.

entries.title: Suggested market prices
changes: Crafting and Loadouts now fill in suggested material prices from the KCDRoleplay auction houses (7-day average sale price, snapshot dated on the page), so costs work straight away.
Anything you type still wins over a suggestion, and a new Use suggested market prices tick box turns them off.

entries.title: What's new button, tour and faster loading
changes: Pages now show a loading message while they build (with a hint if your connection is slow), and a thin bar when you move to another page.
New What's new button in the top bar (this list).
A guided tour of every page, offered on your first visit and available any time from the Tour button.
Pages open faster on repeat visits and now work offline after your first visit.
Crafting: filter by type within each craft (Swords, Helmets, Furniture and more).
Crafting: before you enter prices, Sell at and Profit show a dash so they do not look like real results. There is also a filter box for materials.
Phones: the top bar fits on one row.
Recipes are now checked against the wiki every day.

entries.title: Recipe updates
changes: Tailoring recipes brought in line with the wiki.
New Smithing recipes: Adorned axe (from the relic) and Henry's sword reforged. Broken axe and Henry's longsword can now be priced as materials.
Safer handling of saved loadouts and restored backups.
